one_liner: Corporate card, expense management, bill pay, procurement, and finance automation platform
access_notes: Admins can create a developer app to get client_id/client_secret; multi-tenant apps require a partner application and production review.
blocker_notes: Production distribution requires joining the Technology Partner Program and separate app production approval.

evidence.quote: Ramp uses OAuth 2.0. Your app gets an access token from ‘/developer/v1/token’, authenticating with its client ID and secret (typically HTTP Basic Auth)…
Publishing an app for other Ramp businesses takes two approvals: a partner application… and a production access application for your app…
Sandbox API base URL: ‘https://demo-api.ramp.com’ … The sandbox uses a separate API base URL and app credentials from production.
Canonical OpenAPI schema for the Developer API: /openapi/developer-api.json.
Every webhook request from Ramp includes an ‘X-Ramp-Signature’ header, which contains an HMAC-SHA256 hash of the raw request body, signed with your webhook secret.
Ramp MCP connects AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor to your Ramp account. Each connection acts as the signed-in user, with that user's Ramp permissions.
